messages.subject: Error with dataProcess(featureSubset = "highQuality")
parts:
Hello MSstats team!

I am receiving an error when trying to normalize my data with dataProcess and setting my featureSubset argument = "highQuality". I am working with a MaxQuant output, and this error is only present when selecting this option (I am not having this error when featureSubset = 'all' or 'topN'.

I am writing a sample of the command I am using and the error. Please let me know if you need more details to reproduce this error. 

processeddata <- dataProcess(raw = data,
                                 normalization = 'equalizeMedians',
                                 featureSubset = "highQuality")
